minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  April 26, 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
960 5053 9618 Passcode: 017243 at 9:40 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Anna Ma, Police Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of April 12, 2021, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Axon Enterprise, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing training
  services to the Police Department in the amount of $2,250.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Closed Session - Confidential

3. Closed session-Confidential-Attorney/Client Privileged; Executive closed session Claims Review
  Committee with Legal Counsel regarding pending litigation pursuant to California Government
  Code §54956.9(d)(2)); Rubin vs City of Inglewood. Case 2:20-cv-00319-MWF-E. Motion carried
  unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 9:50 a.m. Adjournment
